messages:
jamie: Cutting RC candidate now — artifact=redwood-api:2026.06.1-rc1. Need QA smoke, kv-warm, artifact pin, and release-notes update. Change window target 09:00-11:00 PT tomorrow. Who can sign off by EOD?

alex: Starting QA smoke on staging. Running `./smoke.sh --suite=quick` now.

maria: KV-warm scheduled for canary-e2 at 02:30 PT. Will post when warm complete.

deploy-bot: RC created and queued: `create-rc --artifact=redwood-api:2026.06.1-rc1 --tag=rc1` — deploy job id queued.

sre-oncall: Oncall ack. I'll monitor p50/p95, error rate, and service-level alarms.

jamie: Pin requested in release board: https://internal/redwood/releases/2026.06.1-rc1 — please update release notes with the short changelog.

taylor: Quick pass on notes done — added a blurb about prefix-caching improvements. Security needs to sign off on env var tweak.

sam: Security review: the env var change is low risk. Add it to audit log and note KMS key id rotation. :white_check_mark:

maria: KV-warm complete on canary — p95 latency improved ~30ms.

alex: QA smoke green. Logs: 
```
OK smoke tests: 0 failures
API /v1/generate median latency 82ms
```

jamie: OK — calling for promote at 09:00 PT tomorrow if approvals are present. Approvals requested from @sam @taylor @sre-oncall. If no objections, I'll pin and schedule the promote. :shipit:

taylor: I'm good.

sre-oncall: ACK. Will set metric watch: alert if error rate > 0.5% (5m).

alex: Suggest adding fallback model in promote step: `--fallback-model redwood-lite` in case capacity tensions show up.

deploy-bot: Note: autoscaler in us-west-2 currently at ~30% spare capacity.

jamie: Rollback plan documented: immediate `rollback --to=redwood-api:2026.05.4` and `traffic shift stable 100%` if we detect regressions. Runbook updated with steps and comms template.

maria: Promote traffic ramp plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 15m increments. I'll be on standby to abort and flip traffic if metrics spike.

jamie: Last call for objections — if none by 18:00 PT today I'll pin artifact and open the promo window.

sam: No objections from security.

alex: No objections. Note: DB migration flag `feature.flag.db_index_v2` will remain OFF during promo; enabling will be a separate rollout.

jamie: Pin complete: artifact pinned on boards and release page. @deploy-bot please schedule promote job.

deploy-bot: Promote scheduled for 09:00 PT 2026-06-12 in prod-us-west-2. Job id=promote-1745558888-01. Includes `--fallback-model redwood-lite`.

sre-oncall: I'll be listening on #sheriffs during the lift. Pager on any >1% error or p95 > 500ms.

alex: Post-deploy smoke will run automatically. CI link: https://ci/redwood/jobs/promote-1745558888-01

jamie: Thanks all. I'll post the final release note link after promote completes and file the cut summary. Good coordination. :tada:
